subject: Harness T4: probe runner — 3 arms (our-way DAG read · search-RAG control · cold floor)
description:
Python, stdlib-only (embeddable py312embed, FULL PATH; per note-mqgz977tbqe). Build bench/agent-memory/probe_runner.py using T3's ConversationIngester (ingest.py) + zonoid_lifecycle.py. For each conversation+probe, run 3 arms and emit per-probe records to results.jsonl {arm, conv_id, qid, category, question, gold, predicted}.

ARM our-way (DAG read): mint the probe as a TASK node via the file-drop stub (spike note-mqgwr63ms7q step 2: drop {id,subject,status:"pending"} JSON under <CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA|~/.claude/orchestrator>/tasks/<workspaceKey(ws)>/<harness>/<id>.json; key="<harness>/<id>"); drive ingest via POST /overlay/status status:"not_ready" (NOT in_progress — trips the claim gate) so autowire seeds note→probe candidate edges; run the REAL LLM edge-judge (claude -p) to choose which candidate session notes to KEEP — **BLIND, WITHOUT the gold answer or evidence labels** (this is the honesty bar — the keep decision must not see gold, or it is an oracle leak); keepEdge the chosen sessions via POST /judge/verdict {verdicts:[{keepEdge}]}; READ GET /task/context?key=<probe>&workspace=<ws> (returns ONLY kept weight>0 sessions; unkept/pruned are weight-0 filtered — robust per override note-mqgwrh5a63x); answer from ONLY those summaries via claude -p. Do NOT use /search?task_key= (RAG-fill leak on provisional/isolated ws).

ARM search (retrieval-time control): same ingested graph; answer from GET /search?q=<question>&workspace=<ws> top-k session summaries via claude -p. The apples-to-apples 'normal RAG memory' arm.

ARM cold (floor / rigging guard): answer with NO memory (or only the latest session) via claude -p.

All arms share the same answerer model + answer-prompt template + k. The gold answer + evidence labels are used ONLY by the scorer (T5) later — NEVER by the runner's retrieve/keep/answer steps. Scope: probe_runner.py ONLY (not scorer/scorecard). Verify against the live daemon on the fixture (≥1 probe; all 3 arms produce an answer; our-way's /task/context returns the kept evidence session). Commit on the attempt branch before complete_task.

summary: Built bench/agent-memory/probe_runner.py (+ mcp-off.json) on attempt branch, commit 126b633. Answers QA probes 3 ways over an already-ingested isolated workspace, sharing one claude -p answerer + one answer template. our-way (DAG read): mint probe as file-drop task stub -> status:not_ready+summary fires ingest funnel (embed+autowire) -> BLIND claude -p edge-judge (sees ONLY question+candidate session transcripts, never gold/evidence labels) picks evidence sessions -> assert judged context edges (createEdge) for kept sessions -> read dependencySummaries off GET /task/context (weight-0 filtered) -> answer from those only; never /search?task_key=. search: GET /search top-k -> answer. cold: no memory. Output: one JSONL record/(probe,arm) {arm,conv_id,qid,category,question,gold,predicted}+diagnostics; gold recorded for scorer only, never in any prediction path. Honesty bar confirmed blind. VERIFIED live (locomo10 fixture, daemon up): --verify PASSes all 6 assertions; full run answers single-hop q1 (focaccia) AND multi-hop q2 (ciabatta) correctly via our-way while plain search retrieves wrong session for q2 and answers "I don't know" — the headline win. KEY FIX recorded as note-mqh0gwz1mxc: keep uses createEdge not keepEdge (keepEdge only promotes pre-existing autowire candidates, silently no-ops on sessions whose autowire cosine <0.55 — broke multi-hop). Windows quirks recorded as note-mqh0h2hktq7: claude -p prompt MUST go via stdin (positional long args mangled by .cmd shim) + resolve CLI via shutil.which + force utf-8. Scorer/scorecard NOT built (out of scope).
